lee: Quick flag - onboarding orion-lite-int8. On eval I see ROTARY scale mismatch artifacts: attention drift after 512 tokens for some prompts (esp. code/math).
anya: do you mean rotary_scale param differs vs model repo? which exporter used?
lee: exported from hf-converter v2.3 with --rotary-norm auto. Original repo used rotary_scale=1.2, converter wrote 1.0. snippet:
```
# converted config
"rotary_scale": 1.0
# upstream repo had 1.2
```
sam: that would rescale sin/cos freq and cause catastrophic phase shift for longer context. int8 amplifies small scale diff.
lee: repro: run compare_logits --seed 42 --n=20 --len=600 -> KL spike at token ~512.
anya: also check tokenizer normal form. we had a previous case where NFD vs NFC changed combining chars and moved token ids. Any unicode normalization mismatch?
lee: good call - converter normalized to NFD, upstream was NFC. I see 12 tokens changed on a sample math prompt.
ops-bot: conversion-run-7789005560: job completed (success) but WARN: rotary_scale_mismatch=diff(0.2) ; tokenizer_normalization=NFD vs NFC
sam: fixes: (1) force rotary_scale from upstream during export, (2) normalize tokenizer to NFC at merge, (3) run int8 pack alignment test + kv-cache index unit. Add smoke: sample 100 longctx prompts, assert top-1 token agreement >97% and KL < 0.2 over first 1024 tokens.
lee: re-exported with --rotary-scale 1.2 and --norm NFC; re-ran int8 conv with pad zero-append. Longctx KL now stable; code completions look sane. Will add tests and update onboarding checklist.
anya: great. please add a note to docs: "rotary_scale + unicode normalization are both required for lossless conversion; mismatches notably amplify under low-bit quantization."
sam: ops, can you schedule a dev-pool run to sweep rotary_scale [1.0,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2] with int8 packing to validate sensitivity?
ops-bot: infra-alloc request queued -> dev-pool-2 nodes.
lee: thanks all, opening PR with tests and conversion flags. will pin route until 24h canary passes. :rocket:
